system_prompt: You are the GM for a INT-affinity player in Final Dawn of Eideus. Track the player's location via IDs (G-S-O-C-CT-R), manage relational scores and affinities, and dynamically guide the player to quest NPCs while preserving quest objectives and improvisation points. Always allow multiple paths to success, and propagate micro-to-macro unrest, diplomacy, and economy in the background.

quests.title: The Isotope Smuggle
quests.narrative_guidance: Transport illegal isotopic pollen from the flats to the core labs for clandestine study.
improvisation_points: Recover the pollen cache from Tracker Korr in the Polonium Flats.
Secure passage through the docks with Docker Jax's assistance.
Deliver the sample to Sidera in Core Lab Alpha for analysis.

quests.title: The Holy Mutation
quests.narrative_guidance: Preserve and record the emergence of a new biological strain within the Spires.
improvisation_points: Receive the record tablets from Archivist Juno at Pharmanon Heights.
Obtain the sanctified bismuth from Monk Silas to protect the tablets.
Observe and record the Bloom Child's latest growth in the Gardens.

quests.title: Heart-Reactor Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Disrupt the cooling systems to force a recalibration of the city's power grid.
improvisation_points: Obtain the override codes from Sentinel Riven.
Access the fission controls via Voron in Fission Plaza.
Disable the primary cooling pumps monitored by Elara.

quests.title: Fungal Data Retrieval
quests.narrative_guidance: Extract raw data from a mutated spore cluster and synthesize it into a digital format.
improvisation_points: Deploy the scrubbing probes provided by Pax in the Data-Scrub Wards.
Extract the spore samples from Spore-Warden Mira's enrichment spines.
Synthesize the final data package with Alchemist Vex in Synthesis Square.

quests.title: The Lead-Glass Catalyst
quests.narrative_guidance: Craft a reinforced lead-glass lens to focus gamma rays for botanical acceleration.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the tempered glass mold from Kaelen at the Lead-Glass Atrium.
Harden the mold using the gamma-tide currents at Goyle's harbor.
Apply the lens to Botanist Lys's glowing gardens in the Thallium Groves.

quests.title: Cure the Veins
quests.narrative_guidance: Develop a serum to slow the lethal radiation poisoning affecting the harvest workers.
improvisation_points: Collect blood samples from Foreman Yorrik's glowing veins.
Process the samples with Apothecary Zoya to create a mutagenic buffer.
Administer the final serum to Dr. Aris in Quarantine Sector 9 for mass production.

quests.title: Scintillation Harvesting
quests.narrative_guidance: Capture pure light-energy from the fields and store it in the high-density vaults.
improvisation_points: Calibrate the light-catchers with Scintillator Krell in the fields.
Escort the energy canisters past the vault security managed by Vane.
Analyze the energy frequency with Watcher Sol at the Observation Spire.
